playpause.note: Rusted metal button seated well in stone surround. Emissive orange/red glow fits theme.

prev.note: Matches play/pause button style, clear icon.

next.note: Matches play/pause button style, clear icon.

queue.note: Clear layout icon, reads well as an engraved metallic button.

vol.note: Excellent dial with runes, gothic detailing and glowing red pointer.

seek.note: Slider track set into stone with a skull handle. Track fill overlay is solid orange (CSS placeholder) but the base design is strong.

shuffle.note: Bone lever in stone recess with ember glow at the base. Looks great.

visualizer.note: Frame is nicely detailed with gothic metal and stone, but the visualizer itself just shows CSS barcode bars at the bottom.

album_art.note: Beautiful gothic stone and metal frame with snake detailing. Screen reflection looks good.

notes: Very strong adherence to the Diablo / Baldur's Gate dark gothic brief.
Materials look like real stone, rusted iron, and bone.
The glowing runes and ember cracks in the stone give it a fantastic dark fantasy vibe.
The skull handle on the seek slider and the bone lever for shuffle are wonderful thematic touches.
Only minor issue is the CSS overlays on the seek slider and visualizer which hide some of the underlying art.
improve: Ensure the seek track handles the CSS fill more gracefully so it doesn't just look like a flat orange rectangle.
Integrate the visualizer graphics better into the screen area rather than just red bars at the bottom.
